event_order: Exactly START then FINISH per attempted cell, in registered order.
counting: START atomically consumes one process and one inference call before spawn; an unfinished START is terminal.
stop: Any unsuccessful process or strict-invalid payload FINISH is terminal and bars later START events.
prestart_terminal: A route/plan failure after gates but before the next START writes append-exclusive execution/TERMINAL.json with counts equal to valid ledger-derived prior START/FINISH pairs and bars all later cells. At zero prior calls the counts are 0/0. Ledger replay precedes terminal validation; disagreement fails closed without erasing prior evidence.
collision: Ledger, captures, and RAW files are append-exclusive and never overwritten.
